source_crosswalk.rationale: Support pre-established composites in the initial release. End-user creation and maintenance of composites are outside that release's scope. The full target removes inherited release deferrals; policy choices remain subject to approval.

Support configurable grouping and eligibility criteria even though the initial composite catalogue is pre-established. The full target removes inherited release deferrals; policy choices remain subject to approval.

Support operational reporting and the institution's stated GIPS-aligned reporting objectives. The source does not provide a complete compliance specification. The full target removes inherited release deferrals; policy choices remain subject to approval.

Support creation, maintenance and governance of composite groupings through the agreed operational model, subject to the initial-release restriction on end-user authoring. The full target removes inherited release deferrals; policy choices remain subject to approval.

Automatically assign portfolios using configurable tracking model, mandate type, base/reference currency and other institution-defined attributes. The full target removes inherited release deferrals; policy choices remain subject to approval.

Maintain separate pre-established tracks by mandate, risk level and portfolio reference currency. The source describes separate USD and SGD tracks across applicable strategies and risk levels. The full target removes inherited release deferrals; policy choices remain subject to approval.

Apply membership changes prospectively by calculation month by default. Previously reported periods remain locked unless an approved historical recalculation follows a material data error, correction or governed rules change. The full target removes inherited release deferrals; policy choices remain subject to approval.

A mandate, risk-profile or reference-currency change excludes the portfolio for the transition month. Entry to the new composite requires the applicable month-end eligibility test. The full target removes inherited release deferrals; policy choices remain subject to approval.

Retain complete effective-dated membership history, with inclusion, exclusion and re-entry dates and reasons. The full target removes inherited release deferrals; policy choices remain subject to approval.

Allow membership review over the selected reporting period, including up to five years or since inception where supporting history exists. The full target removes inherited release deferrals; policy choices remain subject to approval.

Distinguish portfolios included in calculations, excluded under eligibility rules and no longer present in the current input population. The full target removes inherited release deferrals; policy choices remain subject to approval.
Retain closed portfolios in historical datasets when required to calculate historical composites. The full target removes inherited release deferrals; policy choices remain subject to approval.

Automatically include or exclude portfolios using configurable business rules and retain an audit trail of decisions. The full target removes inherited release deferrals; policy choices remain subject to approval.

Support account status, significant cash flows, accreditation, nationality restrictions, product restrictions, deployment status, deceased status, client restrictions and other agreed criteria. The full target removes inherited release deferrals; policy choices remain subject to approval.

Support daily event/status inputs, effective-dated status history, month-end snapshots and full-month aggregations. The full target removes inherited release deferrals; policy choices remain subject to approval.

Define each rule's input frequency, observation window, evaluation point, exclusion period and re-entry conditions. Daily data must not automatically imply daily composite membership changes. The full target removes inherited release deferrals; policy choices remain subject to approval.

Assess each target calendar month using each rule's observation and evaluation method. Exclusion applies to that monthly composite and its resulting YTD chain; earlier eligible reported months remain locked unless an approved correction/recalculation occurs. The full target removes inherited release deferrals; policy choices remain subject to approval.

Evaluate all applicable rules and retain every applicable exclusion reason, not only one primary reason. The full target removes inherited release deferrals; policy choices remain subject to approval.

When a condition is resolved, stop applying that reason at the next relevant eligibility assessment while preserving its historical record. Re-entry requires all applicable conditions to be satisfied. The full target removes inherited release deferrals; policy choices remain subject to approval.

Calculate and maintain composite performance for eligible portfolios using the institution's agreed methodology. The full target removes inherited release deferrals; policy choices remain subject to approval.

Support time-weighted rate of return (TWRR) and maintain gross-of-fee and net-of-fee results where required. The full target removes inherited release deferrals; policy choices remain subject to approval.

Use portfolio performance data supplied by the institution or calculated by the agreed calculation service; ownership must be confirmed. The full target removes inherited release deferrals; policy choices remain subject to approval.

Produce results by mandate, risk level and reference currency for 1M, 3M, 6M, YTD, 1Y, 3Y, 5Y and since inception. The full target removes inherited release deferrals; policy choices remain subject to approval.

Support calendar-year reporting and distinguish cumulative from annualized returns. The source uses “annualised returns by calendar year”; the exact presentation convention remains to be validated. The full target removes inherited release deferrals; policy choices remain subject to approval.

Confirm calculation methodology, fee basis, history requirements and treatment of unavailable history before implementation acceptance. The full target removes inherited release deferrals; policy choices remain subject to approval.
Digitize the institution's governance process for errors in reported performance. The full target removes inherited release deferrals; policy choices remain subject to approval.

Aggregate and net qualifying external cash-flow transactions over the complete target calendar month. Source business types include Transfer, Incoming Payment, Money Transfer and Payment. The full target removes inherited release deferrals; policy choices remain subject to approval.

Compare the monthly net amount with the previous month-end AUM. A ratio of at least 10% excludes the portfolio for the full target month. The full target removes inherited release deferrals; policy choices remain subject to approval.

Do not exclude solely because one transaction exceeds the threshold if later transactions bring the month's net amount below the threshold. The full target removes inherited release deferrals; policy choices remain subject to approval.
Evaluate next-month re-entry using the target month-end drift eligibility test. The full target removes inherited release deferrals; policy choices remain subject to approval.

Fix the threshold at 10% in the current phase; support user configurability through a future configuration journey. The full target removes inherited release deferrals; policy choices remain subject to approval.
Support configurable significant-flow treatment more generally. The full target removes inherited release deferrals; policy choices remain subject to approval.
Support configurable grace periods and automatic exclusion until onboarding criteria are met. The full target removes inherited release deferrals; policy choices remain subject to approval.
Exclude the calendar month in which the portfolio's performance start date falls. The full target removes inherited release deferrals; policy choices remain subject to approval.

Entry from the next full calendar month requires fully discretionary status, funding and substantial investment, evidenced by the applicable month-end drift or cash test. The full target removes inherited release deferrals; policy choices remain subject to approval.
Automatically include the portfolio once all onboarding and other eligibility criteria are satisfied. The full target removes inherited release deferrals; policy choices remain subject to approval.
Support performance calculation and reporting at composite and underlying asset-class levels. The full target removes inherited release deferrals; policy choices remain subject to approval.
Support configurable asset-class structures and aggregation into overall composite results. The full target removes inherited release deferrals; policy choices remain subject to approval.
Export asset-class results to Excel. The full target removes inherited release deferrals; policy choices remain subject to approval.

Confirm carve-out methodology, output layout and detailed calculation specification. The sample described in S0 contains portfolio-level data and composite reporting only. The full target removes inherited release deferrals; policy choices remain subject to approval.
Calculate and report agreed composite risk metrics when the required performance and market data exist. The full target removes inherited release deferrals; policy choices remain subject to approval.

Support configurable metrics; prototype discussion included volatility, Sharpe or another risk-return ratio, and maximum drawdown. The full target removes inherited release deferrals; policy choices remain subject to approval.
Define and supply benchmark/reference and risk-free series when a metric needs them. The full target removes inherited release deferrals; policy choices remain subject to approval.

Confirm the metric catalogue, periods, annualization, risk-free series, benchmark ownership, information ratio requirements and initial-release scope. Risk analytics may be deferred. The full target removes inherited release deferrals; policy choices remain subject to approval.

Produce scheduled reports under an agreed calculation calendar. Daily data may support eligibility; final membership and performance are produced at the agreed monthly calculation point. The full target removes inherited release deferrals; policy choices remain subject to approval.
Clearly identify provisional latest-month results in interim output. The full target removes inherited release deferrals; policy choices remain subject to approval.
Support historical retrieval and Excel export. The full target removes inherited release deferrals; policy choices remain subject to approval.
